objective: Seek one bounded FUTO microgrant to harden MIT-licensed Local Knowledge Terminal as user-controlled, local-first software without counting an application or award as customer revenue.

program.published_fit: FUTO invites grant applications and publishes one-time USD 1,000–5,000 microgrants for small or early-stage projects; it notes that many microgrants are unsolicited.
program.policy: The current official page verifies that grant applications are open by email and publishes the USD 1,000–5,000 microgrant range. It publishes no deadline, geography, agreement, IP, payout, tax, or decision-time terms, so none are inferred.

supported: Local retrieval and Qwen inference can run without a cloud API
Accepted knowledge is stored in SQLite and the graph is a rebuildable projection
Project-owned examples expose exact source spans, source hashes, reviewed relations, and portable JSON
The public offer and repository keep private collections, model weights, and generated data outside Git

license_audit.boundary: The MIT code license is explicit. It does not grant rights to private or third-party books, documents, corpora, model weights, or customer material.

milestones.name: Reproducible local lifecycle
milestones.deliverable: Raspberry Pi/Linux code-only install, update, uninstall, and offline smoke tests

milestones.name: Rights-cleared proof collection
milestones.deliverable: Synthetic or openly licensed starter data, an explicit corpus boundary, and deterministic provenance validation

milestones.name: Portable evidence
milestones.deliverable: Export/import regression tests for cards, sources, relations, and revision history

milestones.name: Bounded MCP and release
milestones.deliverable: Hardened read-only MCP surface, tagged release, operator guide, and bounded results report

submission_checks: The exact existing business mailbox and public grant route were verified
The requested amount is within the published range and the four milestones total USD 5,000
The one-page attachment is one page and contains the same milestone budget
proposal.acceptance_gate: Clarify geographic eligibility, agreement, IP, payout, tax, reporting, and timing terms before accepting any award.

application.method: One concise application from the existing business mailbox with one one-page PDF milestone budget attached
application.delivery_evidence: The isolated visible browser showed the public grant address, exact subject, revised body, and one 21 KB PDF attachment before one send action. The composer closed, and the exact subject then appeared once in Sent. Private screenshots remain ignored and mode 0600.

inbound_monitor.policy: A later aggregate increase creates a review alert only. It does not prove a human reply, eligibility, an award, payment, received funding, or customer revenue.

application.policy: Do not follow up before the review date. A reply, requested detail, eligibility confirmation, award discussion, or award notice requires separate review and is not received funding or customer revenue.

funnel.policy: An application, reply, award notice, or promised grant is not customer revenue. Record received grant funding separately and only after funds settle.
